cards.title: The calculator
cards.text: A model's mental arithmetic slips, so it hands the sum to code. No setting, no network.

cards.title: Many sums, one call
cards.text: Every call is another request to the model, so all the sums go at once, up to 60.

cards.title: A bad sum alone
cards.text: It says why it can't be worked out, and the rest still answer.

cards.title: Four decimals
cards.text: Finer than anyone cooks or shops by, in plain digits with a point.
